authority: Canonical physical holding-capacity and guard-density rules for prisoner custody. Capacity is derived from exact custodian manpower and the real holding environment; no global dungeon-capacity state exists.
rule: A surrender may be held only if the exact custodian formation and physical site can support it. Fortified fixed detention derives space from registered perimeter/garrison geometry; field custody is guard-limited open-air holding. Emergency capacity is temporary and mechanically worsens enclosure/escape risk.
